development_constraints: This development bundle is contract-execution-ready but cannot satisfy a stable dependency.
Passing the bundle gate proves bundle integrity; it does not claim producer or host-driver conformance.
No compatibility promise begins before a signed stable release.
client_visible_changes: 0.26.0 adds no route and preserves the 45 routes of 0.25.0 (ADR 0048, design 30 section 8). driver keeps its two words; a confinement adapter is never a driver value and no adapter name reaches the client wire.

Ten optional family facts are new, one per confinement family in ADR 0044 decision 1 order (ADR 0048 D2): confinement.family.process-run, confinement.family.process-watch, confinement.family.output-read, confinement.family.wait, confinement.family.workspace, confinement.family.filesystem-view, confinement.family.network-egress, confinement.family.network-ingress, confinement.family.limits and confinement.family.audit. Each is const true when the serving adapter proved the family and absent otherwise, never false. A snapshot that states none of them keeps its bytes and digest.

Seven optional property facts are new, one per mechanism-neutral property in the Fact order of spec/confinement (ADR 0048 D3): confinement.paths-are-host-paths, confinement.whole-tree-kill, confinement.ipc-socket-allowlist, confinement.ipc-signals-contained, confinement.sealed-paths, confinement.exec-subpaths and confinement.private-tmpdir, each const true when proved and absent otherwise. The Linux facts exec.namespaces, exec.cgroup-limits, exec.cgroup-kill and exec.no-egress and the neutral confinement.no-egress keep their bytes and meanings.

The sandbox of an exec start, and so of a session start, gains the optional closed object sandbox.requires (ADR 0048 D4): families, a unique list of family names, and facts, a unique list of property names, each without its fact prefix. An unknown name, a duplicate, an empty list, an empty object or another member is request.schema-invalid (422). A start without requires is answered exactly as under 0.25.0, and the exec record's requested sandbox carries requires when the start did.

Two refusals are new, each unserved, 501 and not retriable, each recorded as refused before dispatch and published with a vector: confinement.family-unserved (address sandbox.requires.families) names the first required family the start's snapshot does not serve, in ADR 0044 decision 1 order, and confinement.fact-unserved (address sandbox.requires.facts) the first required property it does not prove, in the Fact order. Both are checked after exec.capability-stale and before every field-specific check.

The applied record echoes requires when the start carried it: every family and property it names was checked and held. Its cgroup becomes optional (ADR 0048 D5): present whenever the adapter applied a cgroup, as on every host run, and absent when it applied none. A client that reads cgroup as required must accept its absence before it moves to 0.26.0.

The vector schema's three machine setup shapes admit each new fact as const true. The two new refusal vectors set up a host machine that serves every family but network-ingress and network-egress and proves whole-tree-kill, ipc-socket-allowlist and ipc-signals-contained, the linux adapter's set without an aperture.
